If true, the browser extension is enabled
BrowserExtensionInstalledTimestamp
Timestamp when browser extension was installed
BrowserExtensionInstallMethod
Install method of the browser extension:
UNIDENTIFIED (0x00): Browser extension install method can't be identified
BROWSER (0x01): Browser extension installed by default with browser
WEBSTORE (0x02): Browser extension installed from browser store
GPO (0x03): Browser extension installed by enterprise policy using GPO
SIDELOADED (0x04): Browser extension installed in dev mode
WEBSTORE_3RD_PARTY (0x05): Browser extension installed from third-party extension store
